name: input
title: Input
description: Single-line text input in two sizes (sm, md) with optional leading/trailing icons and addons (prefixes, units, keyboard hints, icon buttons). Invalid, disabled and read-only states; works inside Field. Opt-in `clearable` adds a labelled reset button; `clearOnEscape` consumes Escape only while the editable input has text. `onClear` runs after the value change and `clearLabel` overrides the localized name. Optional variant: outline (default), filled (secondary surface), or ghost (transparent chrome). FieldVariantProvider supplies the default; explicit props win. Ghost is for obvious editing contexts such as an edit-mode row or toolbar. Alternate variants retain focus, invalid and forced-colors boundaries.
author: gntik-ai
